**Halo: Combat Evolved for Mac** (Apple silicon), the macOS port of [OpenCE](https://github.com/OpenCommunityEdition/OpenCE).

### Install

1. Download **Halo.dmg** below, open it and drag **Halo** into **Applications**.
2. Open **Halo**. The first time, if macOS says that it cannot check the app (it is not notarized): click **Done**, open **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, click **Open Anyway** next to "Halo was blocked", and confirm.
3. At the first start, select your disc image (`.iso` or `.xiso`) of Halo: Combat Evolved for the original Xbox. The game copies its maps (about 2 GB) and starts.

### Requirements

- A Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later); macOS 11 or later (tested on macOS 27).
- Your own copy of the game: the game data is not included.

Halo keeps its maps, saves and settings in `~/Library/Application Support/OpenCE`. Halo is a trademark of Microsoft; this is a fan project, not affiliated with Microsoft, Bungie or Xbox.
